criteria.text: `src/db.ts`'s schema adds `docs.country` (nullable text) via `alter table ... add column if not exists`, plus `create index if not exists docs_country_idx on docs (country)` — checkable by running `pnpm migrate`/tests against a fresh `memory://` database and querying `information_schema.columns`/`pg_indexes`.

`countryOf(domain)` in `src/extract.ts` returns `'pt'` for a `.pt`-suffixed domain, `'br'` for a `.br`-suffixed domain, and `undefined` for every other domain and for `undefined` input — a unit test in `test/extract.test.ts` covering at least `sapo.pt`, `folha.uol.com.br`, `g1.globo.com`, and `undefined`.

Inserting a doc via `store.ts`'s upsert path sets `docs.country` from its `domain` with no separate write; a `reindex.ts` backfill pass (mirroring `backfillDomains`) sets `country` on existing rows where `domain is not null and country is null` and leaves rows with `domain is null` untouched.

`parseCountryList`/`parseScope` (`src/query.ts`): omitted or fully-invalid `country` parses to `'br'` (not `'all'`); `country=all` parses to `'all'`; `country=pt` parses to `'pt'`; `country=br,pt`, `country=all,pt`, and any input naming both `br` and `pt` all parse to `'all'`; `country=xx` (unknown token) parses to `'br'`. Pinned by `test/query.test.ts` round-trip tests across `parseQuery`, `parseDocsQuery`, `parseRisingQuery`, `parseTimelineQuery`, `parseCompareQuery`, `parseWeekQuery`.

`GET /api/people/:id/graph` (default `country`) excludes every `.pt`-country doc from `stats.docs`, `stats.about` and every node's `count`/`pmi`; `GET /api/people/:id/graph?country=all` includes them; `GET /api/people/:id/graph?country=pt` returns only-`.pt` figures. Pinned against `test/fixture.ts`'s new `.pt` doc (see Test plan) in `test/graph.test.ts`.

A `null`-country doc (no domain, or a domain classified neither `br` nor `pt`) is counted under the default `country` scope and under `country=all`, and excluded under `country=pt` — pinned by a fixture doc with `domain: undefined` or a bare `.com` domain.

`precomputable(q)` returns `true` only when `q.country === 'br'` (alongside the existing `domain`/`lean`/`source`/`days` conditions), `false` for `q.country === 'pt'` and `q.country === 'all'` — extends `test/aggregate.test.ts`'s existing `precomputable` describe block.

`graphFor` at the default (`country` omitted) reads from `graph_terms`/`graph_scopes` when a build exists for that window/source, and its output equals the live statement's — extends `test/aggregate.test.ts`'s "renders the same response as the live query" table.

`graphFor` at `country=pt` and `country=all` always falls back to the live statement even after a build exists, and its `docs`/`about` equal the live statement's — extends `test/aggregate.test.ts`'s "falls back to the live query for a domain, a lean or a source list" test with two more cases.

`docs/api.md`'s "Shared filters" section documents `country` alongside `source`/`kind`/`domain`/`lean`: its two valid tokens (`br`, `pt`), that `all` is the explicit way to disable the exclusion, and that the *default differs from every other shared filter's default* (it filters even when omitted). Checked against `test/docs.ts`'s `docsText`, not against any one file's heading or wording.

The docs state, as a fact independent of any file's structure, that a `null`-country document (not yet classified, or classified neither `br` nor `pt`) is kept under the default scope and under `country=all`, and dropped under `country=pt` — checked against `docsText`.

The docs state that the graph aggregate tables hold only the default (`country=br`) universe, and that `country=pt`/`country=all` always run the live statement — checked against `docsText`, phrased as a fact (what the aggregate tables cover), not as a reference to `aggregate.ts`'s comments.

`test/docs-drift.test.ts` is not touched by this issue: it drives collector documentation from the collector registry, and `country` is not a collector or a `source`/`kind` filter value, so no new drift criterion is written there.
